not_verified: The safety rule under CONTENTION. A locally completed instance meeting a NEWER remote row of a different status was never staged on-device. It is also less covered by tests than it looks: shouldApplyRemoteReminderInstance runs as a pure function in packages/shared/src/sync/conflict.test.ts, and apps/mobile/src/sync/pull.test.ts mocks the repository wholesale, so the guard's call site inside reminderInstancesRepo.upsertMany is executed by nothing. Proven of the decision and of the pass, never of the pair.

The rule also has a server-side hole, pre-existing rather than introduced here: packages/convex/convex/reminderInstances.ts markMissed and markSkipped patch status unconditionally, with no check for an already-completed document. A stale push from a second device flips the server copy, and a third install then pulls 'missed' for a dose that was taken.
observations: The push drains only on syncWorker.start() (sign-in) and NetInfo connectivity changes. A reminder created while the app is already running and online sits in sync_queue until one of those fires; the AppState 'active' handler reschedules notifications but does not drain. Both pushes here needed an app restart.
The meds list reads SQLite once on mount, so a pull landing after that read is invisible until the screen is remounted. Showed as 'No medications yet' on the fresh install until re-entry.
The RxNorm result list warns 'Encountered two children with the same key' -- four results share RxCUI 6809 -- and the LogBox overlay blocked the first navigation attempt.
